        AVG(erc."RH") as avg_rh
    FROM dynasty_value_artifacts da
    JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON da."ARTregID" = ca."art_exam"
    JOIN "Showcases" s ON ca."case_exam" = s."caseID"
    JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" erc ON s."caseID" = erc."case_link"
    GROUP BY da."ARTregID"
),
artifact_light_readings AS (
    SELECT 
        da."ARTregID",
        AVG(lrr.lux) as avg_lux,
        AVG(lrr."visLxh") as avg_visLxh
    FROM dynasty_value_artifacts da
    JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON da."ARTregID" = ca."art_exam"
    JOIN "Showcases" s ON ca."case_exam" = s."caseID"
    JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" erc ON s."caseID" = erc."case_link"
    JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" lrr ON erc."monitor_code" = lrr."env_link"
    GROUP BY da."ARTregID"
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        dva."ARTregID",
        dva."DYNASTY",
        dva."ageYears",
        COALESCE(erf.erf, 0) as erf,
        COALESCE(aer.avg_temp, 20) as avg_temp,
        COALESCE(aer.avg_rh, 50) as avg_rh,
        COALESCE(alr.avg_lux, 0) as avg_lux,
        COALESCE(alr.avg_visLxh, 0) as avg_visLxh,
        COALESCE(ase.light_w, 5) as light_weight
    FROM dynasty_value_artifacts dva
    LEFT JOIN erf_calc erf ON dva."ARTregID" = erf."ART_link"
    LEFT JOIN artifact_env_readings aer ON dva."ARTregID" = aer."ARTregID"
    LEFT JOIN artifact_light_readings alr ON dva."ARTregID" = alr."ARTregID"
    LEFT JOIN artifact_sensitivities ase ON dva."ARTregID" = ase."ART_link"
),
mdr_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        c."ARTregID",
        c."DYNASTY",
        c."ageYears",
        c.erf,
        c.avg_temp,
        c.avg_rh,
        c.avg_lux,
        c.avg_visLxh,
        c.light_weight,
        (c."ageYears" * c.erf * POWER(c.avg_rh - 50, 2) * c.avg_temp) / 100000.0 as mdr
    FROM combined c
),
ler_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        m."ARTregID",
        m."DYNASTY",
        m.mdr,
        m.erf,
        (m.avg_lux * m.light_weight * m.avg_visLxh) / 1000.0 as ler
    FROM mdr_calc m
),
tetl_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        l."ARTregID",
        l."DYNASTY",
        l.mdr,
        l.ler,
        l.erf + l.ler + (l.mdr * 2) as tetl
    FROM ler_calc l
),
map_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        t."ARTregID",
        t."DYNASTY",
        t.mdr,
        t.tetl,
        t.mdr * (1 + (t.tetl / 20.0)) as map_score
    FROM tetl_calc t
)
SELECT "DYNASTY", COUNT(*) as at_risk_count
FROM map_calc
WHERE map_score > 3
GROUP BY "DYNASTY"
ORDER BY at_risk_count DESC;
